newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAILAND GIVES HOPEWELL NEW DEADLINE.
newsitem.headline: THAILAND GIVES HOPEWELL NEW DEADLINE.

text.p: Thailand gave Hong Kong's Hopewell Holdings Ltd 10 days to clear up financial difficulties over its mass transit project or face losing the 30-year contract, a senior transport and communications ministry official said on Tuesday.

Sathien Vongvichien, the ministry's deputy permanent secretary, said a government panel monitoring the project on Monday ordered Hopewell to resolve its problems and report back within 10 days or it would propose alternative solutions to the cabinet.
He said these included terminating Hopewell's concession and selecting a new private investor, or asking Hopewell to find other investment partners.
Sathien said the cabinet would be asked to decide the fate of the project later this month.

Hopewell last week discussed for the first time scaling down the multi-billion dollar project with Thai authorities in a bid to end a costly deadlock which has seen only less than 20 percent of the project's 45-km first phase completed.
